description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeePictureAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It implements API endpoints related to retrieving and updating employee pictures, including methods for getOne and update, along with validation rules and external service interactions.

classes.name: EmployeePictureAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints to get and update employee pictures, utilizing services for data access and validation rules for request parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves an employee's picture based on employee number from request parameters, returns a resource result or throws if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or creates an employee's picture record based on uploaded content, adjusts image size, and saves the entity.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne endpoint, ensuring employee number is accessible.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update endpoint, including base64 image data and employee number.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception as delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception as delete validation rules are not supported.
